definitions.attrition: Percentage of the adjusted fall-2024 cohort not returning to the same campus in fall 2025. Source-defined next-grade/unavailable-campus exclusions apply. Retained students, including grade 12, remain. District and state rates use sums of eligible campus numerators and denominators; no dropout inference.
definitions.holds: Mobility, discipline, CTE dots, blank disability Enrollment and total-disability percent remain outside this projection.
definitions.missing: Blank published cells, omitted grade rows and omitted sections remain distinct missing states; no causal eligibility inference or zeros.
definitions.numeric: Counts are integral source tokens; percentages are one-decimal percentage points with exact raw/status/physical coordinates. No masked reconstruction.
definitions.period_convention: 2024-25 names the baseline cohort/prior grade year; observations return/process in fall 2025 (2025-26); publisher edition is 2026.
definitions.retention: Percentage enrolled in fall 2025 in the same grade as the last six-week period of 2024-25; separate non-special-education and special-education populations. Denominator: prior-year students who return the next year or graduate. Only published K-9 percentages; no counts or status-classification date inferred.
definitions.underreporting: Grades 7-12 students served in 2024-25 lacking required leaver reporting after district records/TEA processing. Exclude TxCHSE by August 31, prior Texas public school graduates, enrollment in another Texas public school district, and return by the school-start window ending September 26, 2025. District/state only; this is data quality, not a dropout/leaver count.
